name: oh-skills
description: Personal dev-cycle skills: plan/go/review/fix orchestration, context-rule loader, local knowledge base, bug-tracing, setup doctor, and help reference. Runs on Claude Code, Antigravity (agy), and OpenAI Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Personal dev-cycle skills (plan/review/fix, context, search, bug-tracing)
interface.longDescription: A multi-tool plugin that bundles six personal dev-cycle skills: oh-nice (plan/go/review/fix/do orchestration with parallel DAG dispatch), oh-bug-tracing (bug fix + forensic trace.md post-mortem), oh-context (dynamic domain-rule loader), oh-search (local knowledge base — check before web search), oh-doctor (installation health check), and oh-help (reference card). Runs natively on Claude Code, Antigravity CLI (agy), and OpenAI Codex from one source tree. Configured via .oh-env with agent-role abstraction (CODING_AGENT / REVIEW_AGENT / RESEARCH_AGENT).
defaultPrompt: Find local knowledge before searching the web
